collections.description: Single-tap hopper-game conformance + shippability battery for the eval-game-hoppers web app, driven through pagehub-browser at a 390x844 mobile viewport. Asserts the 5-pillar DOM contract (instant restart, shareable score, creator-friendly difficulty, zero install friction, ads) + gameplay shape (player species in {kangaroo,rabbit,grasshopper,flea,jerboa}; frog forbidden; data-current-lane increments per tap; lane-kind cadence bank/grass/road/riverbed; 3 logs per riverbed; vehicle facing) + mobile design audits (playfield fills >=80% viewport, >=44px tap targets, interstitial reachable without scroll, death-cause, lateral-x preserved, no teleport). Deterministic mode (?deterministic=1 freezes the rAF loop; ?lane-speed/lane-density/seed/die-after/start-x/start-lane) keeps grading timing-stable. Shippability battery (+26 items) adds: native-readiness (viewport-fit=cover, touch-action, safe-area insets, PWA manifest, privacy-link), daily-seed determinism (?today -> seed=daily-<date>), best-score persistence + so-close delta + score-card (localStorage, survives reload), difficulty ramp (data-effective-speed > base at high start-lane), a deterministic collision tier (?scripted-traffic=hit -> road death, =gap -> splash death), a rewarded-continue resume-at-same-lane path, and a reachable-log fairness invariant. Move-consistency (+4 items): a deterministic animation clock-pin (?clock=<ms> freezes the world at that animation-time, positions a pure function of seed/lane/clock; clock=0 = xBase) lets the grader verify a hop does NOT teleport the board — with the clock pinned, every obstacle in a still-visible lane (tracked by stable data-lane-index + data-obstacle-id, with data-x-base the clock=0 origin) holds its exact position across a hop. Requires drift to derive from a monotonic clock, not an epoch that resets on render/hop. 79 items, under the 90 cap.

body.expression: (()=>{const o=[];const vs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-obstacle-kind="vehicle"]'));o.push('vehicles-present='+(vs.length>0?'ok':'fail'));const faced=vs.length>0&&vs.every(e=>{const f=e.getAttribute('data-facing');return f==='left'||f==='right';});o.push('facing-attr-present='+(faced?'ok':'fail'));const L=vs.filter(e=>e.getAttribute('data-facing')==='left');const R=vs.filter(e=>e.getAttribute('data-facing')==='right');o.push('facing-both-present='+(L.length>0&&R.length>0?'ok':'fail'));const sig=e=>getComputedStyle(e).transform+'|'+(e.textContent||'').trim();const ls=new Set(L.map(sig));const rs=new Set(R.map(sig));let disjoint=L.length>0&&R.length>0;for(const s of ls){if(rs.has(s)){disjoint=false;break;}}o.push('facing-visual-distinct='+(disjoint?'ok':'fail'));return o.join('|');})()
